selection_correction.reason: The inherited substitute did not obsolete the parent capability. Mission-lock V4 requires recording the exact residual and continuing only on that residual before selecting a new capability.

causal_trace: The inherited discovery route emits binding_kind=apt and discovery_source=APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN with zero-cost eligibility, version/archive identity, and executable-ownership evidence.
auto_capability_acquisition routes binding_kind=apt to the existing apt_cli acquisition supplier.

auto_apt_cli_acquisition._viable_candidates then rejects every candidate whose discovery_source is not the historical literal APT_CATALOG, so the verified route cannot reach apt_cli_probe or cli_contract_inference.
The same admission function also applies a legacy absolute score>=12 threshold to raw Xapian BM25 match.weight, which is not a portable cross-scorer contract.

Preserved downstream evidence indicates verify_pending_cli_binding also assumes at least two legacy matched_terms while the inherited route emits matched_terms=[], but this is downstream of the deterministic source-admission failure and is not permission to broaden the first repair.
repair_design_constraints: Use stable binding/evidence properties rather than discovery_source name.
Do not compare Xapian BM25 raw weight to the legacy absolute lexical-score threshold as an admission contract.
Do not change the already-verified Xapian supplier-ranking route unless fresh evidence makes that necessary.
Do not repair the downstream matched_terms verifier assumption before the first causal blocker is removed and the fresh gate reaches it.
